title: Monster category
wikitext:
{{Merge to|Monster}}

'''Monster categories''' are groupings of monster types that share a property. Some monster categories are used to populate maps with specific features. In rare cases, [[item]] or [[passive skill]] stats may behave differently based on the monster category or type being fought.

Players can see the monster category a monster belongs to if they have {{il|Veruso's Ambition}} equipped. Some monsters may belong to more than one category, in which case their primary category will be displayed.

Monster categories are:
*[[Beast]] (or "[[Animal]]")
:* [[Ape]]
:* [[Chimeral]]
:* [[Devourer]]
:* [[Goatman]]
:* [[Maw]]
:* [[Rhoa]]
:* [[Snake]]
:* [[Spider]]
:* [[Sand spitter]]
:*[[Shaper Guardian]]

*[[Construct]]

:*[[Totem (monster type)|Totem]]

*[[Demon]]
